title: Puharich meditates in airports, the Nine speak through his watch
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Puharich meditates in airports, the Nine speak through his watch, about 1970s at airports, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Puharich would stop at airports and try and meditate because he thought he would be bringing about world peace and that the Nine would speak to him through his watch

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a man named Puharich, whom his episode calls a CIA scientist who contacted an alien council known as the Nine. Michels says that in the 1970s Puharich would stop in airports to meditate, believing he was helping bring about world peace and that the Nine would speak to him through his watch.
